elvis-presley-debut-album.description: A painted bedroom interior. An open, worn suitcase-style portable record player in the centre plays a black vinyl record. A stack of record sleeves lies on the floor at right; the top sleeve has a pink and green portrait of a dark-haired man. At left, a pair of legs in a green skirt, white socks and white-and-brown saddle shoes stand near a bed with rumpled sheets. A brown loafer is in the lower right foreground, a lamp sits at top right, and a poster hangs on the wall at top left. No legible text is visible.

miles-davis-kind-of-blue.description: A dim, vaulted stone room resembling a converted church, painted in oil. On the left stands an upright piano and beside it an upright double bass. In the centre, a brass trumpet with a small cup-shaped mute rests on a folding wooden chair, and a vintage microphone hangs on a boom stand overhead. Music stands and cables fill the shadowy background, lit by one hanging lamp. No text, frame or people are visible.

dylan-freewheelin-album.description: A snowy city street at night beside a brick townhouse with iron railings and fire escapes. A warm lit window shows a dark silhouette of a person playing an instrument, with another figure beside them. In the foreground an old battered guitar case leans against the steps beside a folded metal music stand. Painterly style, falling snow, a single street lamp at the far right.

beach-boys-pet-sounds.description: A painted, dimly lit interior of a recording room with sunlight slanting through tall windows. A grand piano dominates the centre, with a cello and a double bass, a brass player and a trumpet on a stool in the background. A reel-to-reel tape machine and mixing console sit at right, and two small dogs sit on the floor by the piano. No readable text, no frame.

beatles-sgt-pepper.description: A painted crowd scene: four figures in bright military-style jackets stand before a large dark bass drum, with a crowd of faces behind them. In front, a guitar shape is built from flowers, a painted drum sits at the lower right, and a bust rises from the grass. No text or frame is visible.

beatles-abbey-road.description: A painted, dimly lit tree-lined street seen from the middle of the road. A white Volkswagen Beetle is parked on the left and dark vintage cars sit further down. On the right is a row of white stucco townhouses behind a low brick wall. In the foreground a zebra crossing runs across the frame, with dark footprint-like shadows on the white stripes. No people, no visible text, and the painting fills the whole image edge to edge.

led-zeppelin-iv-album.description: A painted interior of a dark wood-panelled staircase with a carved banister, a drum kit set up on a wooden landing with cymbals and a snare, and microphones hanging on cables from the upper gallery. A seated, shadowy figure sits beside the drums. Through an open door at the back, a vintage dark van is parked on gravel under trees. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

bowie-ziggy-stardust-album.description: A headless mannequin in a harlequin-patterned jumpsuit and red platform boots stands in a spotlight on a worn wooden stage in an old theatre. A lightning bolt is painted on an ornate gilt standing mirror to the right, and an electric guitar leans against a speaker cabinet on the left, with cables on the floor. Dark red curtains and balcony railings frame the background.

pink-floyd-dark-side-album.description: A glass prism stands on a dark, scuffed surface. A bright white beam enters from the upper left and leaves the prism as a rainbow spectrum that spreads across the lower right. Behind it sit several antique clocks with Roman-numeral dials, and a tape reel sits on the right. Cables trail across the dark, painterly oil-style scene. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.

springsteen-born-to-run-album.description: A dark, weathered vintage car with its driver's door open, parked at dusk. On the cracked black leather back seat lie a gold tenor saxophone and a worn sunburst electric guitar, with a crumpled cloth beside them. Behind the car is an ocean with choppy waves, and a pier with a lit Ferris wheel, neon signs and a lone figure walking on the boardwalk. The painting is oil-style and fills the frame edge to edge.

eagles-hotel-california-album.description: A painted nocturne of a Spanish Colonial Revival building with a bell tower and a warmly lit arched entrance, two electric guitars leaning in the doorway. Tall palm trees line a long empty road under a stormy sky with a moon, and a single car's headlights glow in the distance. No visible text, frame or people.

fleetwood-mac-rumours-album.description: A dim, warmly lit recording studio. A large mixing console with rows of faders and knobs fills the centre, with a reel-to-reel tape machine behind it and studio monitors at the top left. In the foreground a low table holds a half-full wine bottle, a glass of red wine, ashtrays with cigarettes, and handwritten lyric sheets. Crumpled paper lies on the floor, and a worn leather chair sits at the right beside tangled cables. The scene is an oil-painting style with no people.

pink-floyd-the-wall-album.description: A large wall of tan and brown stacked bricks fills the centre of a dark, smoky stage, with hanging speakers and stage lights overhead. A small figure sits in an armchair beside a lit floor lamp in a gap in the wall. In the foreground, a row of empty school desks and chairs faces the wall. No visible text, no frame, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.

acdc-back-in-black-album.description: A dim wooden room with a tall stack of black guitar amplifier heads with gold control panels over speaker cabinets, coiled cables on the floor and road cases at the right. A brass bell hangs on a rope in front of an open louvered window showing stormy sea and palm trees. No people, no visible text.

prince-purple-rain-album.description: A dim, purple-lit room with a glossy purple touring motorcycle parked in front of an upright piano, a ruffled purple garment draped over the piano, and a stool in the foreground. Behind them a large window shows rain streaks and blurred city lights, and amplifiers and mic stands sit at left under stage lights with purple haze filling the air. A tiny mark sits in the bottom-right corner, and the painting fills the whole frame with no border.

u2-joshua-tree-album.description: An oil-style painting of a large Joshua tree at golden sunset in a flat desert. An acoustic guitar leans against the trunk at its base. A pale dirt road runs from the foreground to the horizon on the right, with low brown scrub and distant purple mountains. No people, no text, no frame.

madonna-like-a-prayer-album.description: A dim, candle-lit church interior painted in oil. In the foreground a dark wooden pew holds a pair of black lace gloves and a rosary with a crucifix. Rows of candles burn on an altar under a stained-glass window, and black choir robes hang on a rail along the left wall. No people, text, frame or graphic content.

nas-illmatic-album.description: A man in a brown leather jacket sits on brownstone steps at dusk, writing in a small notebook. Beside him are a boombox, a black milk crate of vinyl records, and a folding table holding two turntables and a mixer, with cables trailing off the edge. Behind are brick apartment blocks with fire escapes and lit windows, and a few figures in a courtyard. The painting is warm and painterly, with no visible text, frame or border.

radiohead-ok-computer-album.description: An empty airport departure lounge at night seen through large glass windows. Rows of grey seats line the left and right, and a counter holds four glowing teal CRT-style monitors. Through the glass, a dark jet sits on the lit tarmac under floodlights. The painting is loose and painterly with a reflective floor, no people in focus, and no visible text or frame.

norah-jones-come-away-with-me-album.description: An upright piano in a dark room, lit by a green-shaded banker's lamp on its lid. Six brass gramophone horns sit in a row on top of the piano. A steaming cup of coffee on a saucer rests on the keys. Behind the piano are heavy dark curtains, a wooden chair and a dim stage area. The painting is an oil-style image with no visible text and no frame.

amy-winehouse-back-to-black-album.description: An oil-painting style scene of a dim stage lit from above. A dark-haired head or bun rests against the back of a wooden bar stool, with a black leather jacket draped over the stool. A vintage chrome microphone stands on a stand in front of it, and gold trumpets lean against a dark floor speaker cabinet at right. Cables run across a worn wooden floor. A gilded picture frame is visible at the top left, inside the room. No visible text.

beyonce-surprise-album.description: A dim, empty warehouse-like room with a wooden floor. Stacked old boxy CRT televisions, several showing static or glowing screens, sit on flight cases and cardboard boxes against a back wall. A smartphone rests on top of a box, and a pair of black high heels sits on the floor in front of the stack. Overhead, steel roof trusses are visible, and a reflective surface runs along the left side.

kendrick-to-pimp-a-butterfly-album.description: A dark, glossy 1960s sedan with chrome trim, possibly a Chevrolet Impala, is parked low on a sunny residential street lined with palm trees and single-storey stucco houses. A monarch butterfly rests on the roof, and an open black case holding a saxophone lies on the pavement in front of the car. The style is painterly, like an oil painting, with no frame or border visible. Only the car's rear badge has small lettering, which is part of the car.
